field_name: Temporal Question Answering over Evolving Documents

categories.name: Temporal relevance weighting for overlapping-evolving documents
categories.description: Approaches that adjust retrieval scores based on temporal distance between query and document timestamps to handle versions with high semantic overlap.

categories.name: External memory / knowledge organization for evolving knowledge
categories.description: Building structured external memory from source documents to enable temporally filtered retrieval without retraining.

categories.name: Verification and drift detection for living guidelines
categories.description: Systems that detect updates in guidelines and provide verification reports to ensure use of current version.

categories.name: Summarization-augmented question answering
categories.description: Integrating text summarization with question answering to improve information retrieval performance.

idea_position: Temporal relevance weighting for overlapping-evolving documents
dominant_approaches: Temporal relevance weighting for overlapping-evolving documents
External memory / knowledge organization for evolving knowledge
Verification and drift detection for living guidelines
common_assumptions: Temporal relevance can be modeled as a decreasing function of temporal distance between query and document timestamps.
Semantic and temporal scores can be combined via a weighted sum or scaling factor.
Version timestamps or effective intervals are available at the passage level.
Guideline updates are reflected in versioned documents and detectable via temporal metadata.
Incrementally building a structured external memory from source documents captures evolving knowledge without retraining.
Summarization improves the quality of retrieved information and answer generation in a RAG pipeline.

repeated_limitations.description: Temporal signals may be noisy or incomplete in real-world corpora, affecting the reliability of temporal metadata.
Dependence on the quality of source documents or guideline versioning for accurate temporal modeling.
Evaluation limited to specific datasets, raising concerns about generalizability to other domains or evolving documents.

underexplored_combinations: Combining temporal relevance weighting with verification and drift detection mechanisms.
Integrating external memory organization with temporal relevance weighting for hybrid approaches.
Applying temporal relevance weighting to multimodal evolving documents (e.g., regulations with figures/tables).
